title: Asset provenance record
description: One PROVENANCE.json per asset directory (a record may cover sub-directories). Every file in the directory must be listed. Validated by scripts/validate.mjs (hash, dimensions, required fields per method, licence, status vocabulary) and, when the record carries a contract, measured pixel by pixel by the rasters check.

method.description: How the files came to be. Generated methods need a prompt per raster; design-file export needs a source key, a node id per file, a status and an authorization; shipped-asset copy needs a source key, the repository and commit, a source path per file, a status and an authorization; composition needs the inputs and placements per file

source.description: Source register key the files come from (design-file export, shipped-asset copy)

sourceFile.description: Design file cited by title and file key only; never a URL

sourceRepository.description: Repository, commit, version and path the files were copied from

authorization.description: Who admitted observed material past the publication boundary, when, and the decision record that logs it

status.description: Status of the record's files in the repository vocabulary

sets.description: Named groups of assets in the record (directory, brief, count, families, generation date, decision record and reference inputs). An owner-authorized marked set records its exact authorization scope, depicted-mark geometry and rights; a dense branded set may record edit lineage, while an additive ambient set records its stricter safe-zone thresholds, cube and quiet-area bounds and manual visual-review method independently. Entries cite a set by name and the validator checks the counts without broadening one set's contract into another

contract.description: Pixel-level requirements the rasters check measures: aspectRatio and aspectTolerance, minWidth, minHeight, dimensions, bitDepth, colourType, alphaChannel, cornersTransparent, tight, maxTransparentFraction, contentCredentials, pairs, lightRegister.minSafeZoneLuminance, darkRegister.maxSafeZoneLuminance, maxSafeZoneDeviation and maxMeanAbsoluteDifference. A set may carry stricter thresholds, such as the ambient backgrounds' 220 light, 36 dark and deviation 12 contract, without changing the record-wide slide contract

model.description: Model or software agent as exposed by the tool or by credentials embedded in the files

contentCredentials.description: Provenance embedded in the files themselves (for example a C2PA manifest): standard, software agent, claim generator, actions and signer as read from the file

operator.description: A role label (for example 'design-system maintainer'), never a personal name

license.description: Licence statement for the files in the directory; required and checked by the validator

postProcessing.description: Edits after generation, or a statement that there were none, including delivered versus requested dimensions

path.description: Relative to the directory of the PROVENANCE.json

dimensions.description: Required for raster files; checked against the file header

brief.description: Brief identifier from imagery/briefs.md, for example IB-02

generation.description: For a generated image with inputs: the generation id, the mode (a generation from references, a precise regeneration, or an image edit), the ordered inputs by role and the authorization behind them. A published repository input is recorded by repository-relative path, hash, source key, status and published: true. An unpublished or superseded generated draft or design-file export is cited by source and hash (and, when applicable, frame and node id), status and published: false, never by a local path or temporary URL

edit.description: For a generated image that is a precise-object edit of its own generation output, directly or through a chain of edits: the final edit's generation id, its method, kind (object-replacement, top-plane-cleanup or occlusion-removal for the branded slide backgrounds) and mode, the edit target (the superseded previous output, by hash, generation id and content-credentials time stamp, published: false, status superseded; never a repository file, a local path or a temporary URL), the lineage (every earlier edit of the chain, newest first, each with its id, superseded output and target by hash and time stamp and its verbatim prompt), the object edited, the purpose, the result by visual review, the authorization and the verbatim edit prompt; the entry's generation and prompt stay those of the generation that produced the scene, and the branded lock pins the edit and its lineage

embeddedMarks.description: The marks a file depicts (mark, carrier, count by visual review, how counted, rights); required for a file that shows a mark under a recorded owner authorization, and the set-specific validator pins the count for both branded and ambient slide backgrounds

reconstructed.description: Reserved. The repository ships no reconstruction of a mark under any label (decisions 0007 and 0010); the validator rejects an entry that sets this to true

set.description: Name of the set in the record's sets block

family.description: Family name shared by a light and a dark file

safeZone.description: Text-safe zone as fractions x, y, width, height of the image, with a note and the recorded measurement (meanLuminance, deviation); decoded pixels are measured by the validator against the applicable record-wide or stricter set-specific contract and against the pinned figures

ambientComposition.description: Per-asset ambient composition facts established by full-resolution manual visual review rather than automated segmentation or mark recognition. The ambient validator pins the exact review statement, one normalized subject bound per visually counted cube, the conservative occupied-area and quiet-area bounds, edge bias, centring and minimum subject-to-safe-zone separation; it then checks the normalized rectangles and their declared separation geometrically.

colour.description: Bit depth, colour type and alpha facts as read from the file

contentCredentials.description: Per-file facts read from the embedded manifest, for example the time-stamp authority time

node.description: Design-file node the file was exported from

classification.description: For design-file exports: current design-file screen or exploratory design-file screen

sourcePath.description: Path inside the source repository for shipped-asset copies

composition.description: Inputs of a composed preview: an optional base (path, fit) and placements (path, x, y, width, height), all repository assets with their own provenance
